name: DeepSeek Usage
author: alexpazzo
description: Today's DeepSeek API spend, tokens, cache efficiency and balance from platform.deepseek.com/usage.

barWidget.description: Today's DeepSeek spend in the bar; tokens, requests, cache hits, per-model and per-day totals, plus the official balance, in the panel.

schema.label: Session token file
schema.description: File containing the platform web session token (localStorage.userToken).

schema.label: Token command
schema.description: Optional. Runs via bash -c and prints the token; overrides the token file. Example: secret-tool lookup service deepseek.

schema.label: API key file (balance)
schema.description: Optional. File containing a DeepSeek API key. Falls back to $DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Empty hides the balance section.

schema.label: Usage endpoint base
schema.description: Advanced. Change only if the platform moves its usage API.
